description.value: Ebisu Sushi is a Japanese restaurant in Abbotsford serving sushi and related cuisine. It offers online ordering, making it a convenient stop for cyclists wanting to pre-order a meal. The restaurant occupies a retail unit at 2596 McMillan Rd.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 13m; rack (3 spaces) at 78m. Total: 6 spaces.

The website title includes 'Order Online,' indicating takeout service is available; no other cyclist-relevant amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
